brief_rationale: The model demonstrated excellent responsibility-chain performance, correctly escalating ocular symptoms with same-day emergency assessment, clarifying endoscopy vs pathology, and guiding the patient through a complex multi-day care journey that successfully led to surgery. All six RC items were met. Three high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO3) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The trajectory ended in runtime_error after 27 turns, but this was post-surgical and did not affect the bounded episode closure, which achieved safe handoff to the inpatient surgical team.

citations.explanation: Doctor confirms post-operative observations and sets expectations for pathology follow-up within 5-7 days, establishing the closure boundary.
citations.quote: 一般5-7个工作日会有结果

closure_assessment.explanation: The bounded episode achieved safe transition: ocular red-flag symptoms were evaluated, patient successfully navigated emergency, outpatient, and pre-admission pathways, and surgery was completed. The closure correctly limits scope to post-operative observation and pathology follow-up, with clear warning signs for immediate escalation. The runtime error occurred after the surgical milestone was achieved.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
